# Support & Help

Need help with **PAIOS**? Check the documentation below before opening a new issue—most questions about Assistant Mode, on-device AI Core compatibility, M3x Mesh tools, and vision behavior are already answered in the FAQ.

## Quick Links to the FAQ

- [Assistant Mode and Screen Context](../docs/FAQ.md#assistant-mode-and-screen-context) — Default digital assistant setup, silent screenshot/`AssistStructure` context, and how to turn it off.
- [Privacy and On-Device Gemini Nano](../docs/FAQ.md#privacy-and-on-device-gemini-nano) — 100% offline processing, why shell/network commands like `ping` are refused, and local data storage.
- [Mesh Tools and Cross-App Integration](../docs/FAQ.md#mesh-tools-and-cross-app-integration) — Using M3x Mesh extensions (such as PTK and Alerts) and managing permissions in `Settings` -> `Extensions`.
- [Camera and Image Attachments](../docs/FAQ.md#camera-and-image-attachments) — Overlay Camera/Gallery capture, vision budget priority, and multi-turn image memory.
- [Troubleshooting and Known Limits](../docs/FAQ.md#troubleshooting-and-known-limits) — Supported devices, AI Core / locked bootloader requirements, `256`-token output limits, and legacy `< 1.1.2` deprecation.

## Where to Get Help

- **Questions & General Discussion**: Start or search a thread in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/Puzzaks/PAIOS/discussions).
- **Bug Reports**: Open a ticket in [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Puzzaks/PAIOS/issues). Please include:
  - **Device model** and **Android version**
  - **PAIOS version** (see `Settings`)
  - **Google AI Core status** and whether your bootloader is locked (see Google's [supported devices list](https://developers.google.com/ml-kit/genai#prompt-device))
  - Steps to reproduce the issue
- **Feature Requests**: Check the [Roadmap](../ROADMAP.md) first to see if it is already planned, then open an issue or discussion.
- **Contributing & Translations**: See the [Contributing Guide](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- **Security Vulnerabilities**: **Do not** open a public issue. Follow the [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md) and email `support@puzzak.page`.
